projects.name: FasFas
projects.description: Multi-tenant fashion marketplace platform with brand onboarding, product/inventory management, and admin dashboard. Django REST backend, React Native/Expo mobile app, and Angular web frontend orchestrated with Docker Compose. Features brand auth, catalog parsing, warehouse management, and marketplace APIs.

projects.name: MineMatrix
projects.description: Rule-guarded Reinforcement Learning environment for Minecraft using Mineflayer, Gymnasium, and Stable-Baselines3. Built an RL agent that learns to play Minecraft under custom safety/rule constraints.

projects.name: SQL Saga
projects.description: An interactive terminal game that teaches SQL through a narrative mystery story. Players solve puzzles by writing real queries against an embedded engine.

projects.name: Chatty
projects.description: Secure 1-to-1 WebRTC video calling app with terminal aesthetics. Peer-to-peer encrypted, no recordings/logs persisted. Built-in games (Newlywed, Battleship), chat, screen sharing, and ring light — Go backend with vanilla JS frontend.

projects.name: RIL IMS (Telecom Infrastructure Management)
projects.description: Full-stack telecom inventory platform (RILIMS) for managing data centers, racks, servers, and power analysis. Excel upload with validation, role-based auth (admin/circle_head), and an analytics dashboard with charts.

projects.name: CartPing
projects.description: Shopify app for abandoned cart recovery via WhatsApp for Indian D2C brands. Go backend + React/Vite/Tailwind frontend. Shopify OAuth/webhooks, WhatsApp provider integration, deployed on Oracle Cloud ARM with Nginx.

projects.name: NeuralForm Extension
projects.description: AI-powered Firefox extension (Manifest V3) for intelligent form auto-fill. Detects fields via name/id/placeholder/label/aria and fills personal/contact/address data. Firebase Firestore cloud sync with local fallback, hybrid AI for smart field detection, and a GSAP-animated landing page.

projects.name: mcp-phabricator
projects.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Phabricator. Manage tasks, view revisions, and perform stack-aware code reviews with AI agents.

projects.name: Cipherify
projects.description: Agency website built with GSAP animations and React. Smooth scroll-driven transitions and a polished, motion-heavy UI.

projects.name: Casio Mod (Smartwatch PCB)
projects.description: Custom PCB smartwatch built inside a Casio F91W case. ESP32-C3 Mini, LiPo + charging circuit, custom LCD, magnetic pogo-pin charger. Long-distance watch-to-watch messaging over a Wi-Fi API. KiCad PCB design and ESP32 firmware with NTP sync and low-power UI.

projects.name: Rune (Terminal AI Note Companion)
projects.description: A terminal-based AI note-taking companion. Study topics, co-write markdown notes with an LLM, and preview them live — all from your terminal.

projects.name: codemap.nvim
projects.description: Neovim plugin for competitive programming & scratch work. Two-pane workspace with shared input.txt/output.txt, runs Go/Python/JS/TS/Java/C++/Rust/Ruby, error highlighting, and nvim-dap debugging for Go/Python.

projects.name: bogusvim
projects.description: Personal Neovim configuration. Lua-based setup with plugins, LSP, keymaps, and custom UI tuned for a fast development workflow.

projects.name: Discord Issue Bot
projects.description: Discord bot for GitHub issue management. Creates, tracks, and syncs GitHub issues directly from Discord channels via slash commands for creation, assignment, labels, and status updates.

projects.name: Capitalmini
projects.description: Financial calculator web app with EMI calculator for loans, hero carousel with Swiper, and a responsive UI. Work Sans + JetBrains Mono fonts with a gold/dark palette.

projects.name: Hyrelater (Job Portal)
projects.description: Job portal platform with employer/candidate registration, profiles, job listings, and applications. Django Tastypie REST API + Angular frontend with Bootstrap UI. Auth (signup/login) and PostgreSQL-ready.

projects.name: Mine Companion
projects.description: Minecraft AI/automation project. Mineflayer bot (Node.js) connects to a Paper/Spigot 1.20.x server while a Python RL agent learns to play via reinforcement learning. Offline-mode support for testing.

projects.name: Pearch Plugin
projects.description: Browser companion plugin for Phabricator — quick search and lookup utilities for code reviews and tasks.

projects.name: PhabTask (VS Code)
projects.description: VS Code extension that surfaces tasks assigned to you in Phabricator right inside the editor for faster triage.

projects.name: GitHub Profile Graphs
projects.description: Web app that generates graphs and stats cards for your GitHub profile README from the GitHub API.

projects.name: Tamely
projects.description: Task management app with secure Firebase Authentication. Create, track, and manage tasks with dynamic timers, real-time progress dashboard, sections for completed and dropped tasks, and a detailed project log. Hosted on Vercel.

projects.name: TaskTreasury
projects.description: Web application with auth system and REST API endpoints for task management.

projects.name: ReviewReward
projects.description: Reward-based review platform web app.

projects.name: Review Authenticity Checker
projects.description: API to check if a text review is computer-generated (fake) or original (truthful).

projects.name: Discord Welcome Bot
projects.description: Discord welcome bot for technical servers, designed with a computer-geek aesthetic.

projects.name: RashtriyaTV News
projects.description: News frontend for rashtriyatv.com.
